none: PAS NLM-690AF1: Roman Nummus of Helena from Swinhope
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Helena (324-341), issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helena coifed and draped with mantle right; CR suggests also diademed. Obverse inscription: HELENA [A]VGV[STA]. Reverse description: Pax standing left holding transverse sceptre and branch. Reverse inscription: [PAX PVBLICA]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.
